narration_ml: Section 115BAC(1A) prakaram Individuals, HUF, AOP, BOI, matrum AJP ennivarkku Assessment Year 2025-26 muthal default tax regime slab rates aanu apply aakunnath.

card.title: Applicability of Default Tax Regime
lines: Applicable to Individuals, HUF, AOP, BOI, and AJP.
Effective for Assessment Year 2025-26 and 2026-27.
Governed by Section 115BAC(1A) of the Income-tax Act.
Operates as the default tax regime for all eligible assessees.

narration_ml: Section 4 charge of tax nirdheshikkunnu, athu vazhi Section 115BAC(1A) nalkunna slab rates Total Income-il calculate cheyyanam ennu vyakthamakkunnu.

card.title: Statutory Authority for Tax Charge
lines: Section 4 provides the charge of income-tax.
Tax is levied on the Total Income of the previous year.
Rates are prescribed under Section 115BAC(1A).
Applicable for the relevant Assessment Years.

narration_ml: Section 115BAC(1A) prakaram Total Income naalu laksham roopa vare Nil rate aayirikkum ennum athinu mukalil progressive rates apply aakum ennum nirdheshikkunnu.

card.title: Tax Slab Rates Part 1
lines: Progressive tax rates apply based on income slabs.
The first slab up to ₹ 4,00,000 is exempt.
Rates increase by 5% for every ₹ 4,00,000 increment.
Covers income up to ₹ 12,00,000 in this card.

narration_ml: Naalu laksham roopakku mukalil ulla Total Income-inu anju percent muthal muppathu percent vare ulla progressive tax rates aanu Section 115BAC(1A) nalkunnath.

card.title: Tax Slab Rates Part 2
lines: Higher income slabs attract rates from 15% to 30%.
The maximum marginal rate of 30% applies above ₹ 24,00,000.
Slabs are structured in ₹ 4,00,000 intervals.
Applicable for A.Y. 2025-26 and A.Y. 2026-27.

narration_ml: Total Income ezhu laksham roopa vare aanenkil Section 87A prakaram irupathi-anju ayiram roopa vare ulla Rebate labhikkuvan eligible aanu.

card.title: Rebate Under Section 87A
lines: Rebate is available for resident individuals.
Total Income must not exceed ₹ 7,00,000.
Maximum rebate amount is ₹ 25,000.
Calculated before adding Health and Education Cess.

narration_ml: Aggregate Income Tax-inte mel naalu percent Health and Education Cess nirbandhamayum levy cheyyanam ennu statutory provision nirdheshikkunnu.

card.title: Health and Education Cess
lines: Levied at a rate of 4% on aggregate income-tax.
Calculated after allowing Rebate u/s 87A.
Mandatory for all categories of assessees.
Added to the tax liability to arrive at final tax payable.

narration_ml: Senior Citizens-inu prathyeka Basic Exemption Limit ee regime-il illennathum, ella age categories-inum naalu laksham roopa uniform aayirikkum ennathum shradhikkenam.

card.title: Uniform Basic Exemption Limit
lines: Basic Exemption Limit is fixed at ₹ 4,00,000.
Applies universally across all age categories.
No higher exemption for Senior or Super Senior citizens.
Age-based benefits are not available under Section 115BAC(1A).

narration_ml: Section 115BAC(1A) oru default regime aanennathum, ithu opt-out cheyyathidatholam ella Individuals-inum ee slab rates mathrame apply aaku ennu manassilaakkanam.

card.title: Default Regime Conditions
lines: Section 115BAC(1A) is the default tax regime.
Assessees must specifically opt-out to choose the old regime.
Slab rates are specific to the default regime only.
Ensure correct Assessment Year application (2025-26 onwards).
